title: 第19章 谁让你骂我妈的第20章 陨铁剑显神威
slug: 双修暴击十万次仙子倒贴求放过
content_zh:
“此人能够看透他们使用了掩盖气息的宝物，那他身上大概率也有这么一件宝贝。
不仅如此，璃月宗征讨筑基强者，竟然带着一位练气期的老者，这不是主动给他们创造突破口吗？这老者还有些仙风道骨……如今又使出了激将法……谁会动手？傻子才会动手。”
看到黑袍首领畏惧不前，顾平心头一愣。
魔修的脸皮真够厚的，这还不出手？
“算了，跟你说也是白费，把你老大叫出来吧，让他和我谈。”
黑袍金丹阴恻恻的笑着，“老道，你也莫要逞口舌之力，你这激将法在我这里不管用。”
他显得很有耐心，就是不愿意先手攻击。
顾平一看，这不行啊。
“去你妈的，我看你真没出息。”
顾平骂了一句，就要把楚玉抱起来，准备往外走。
但是他没想到的是，这一次，他骂的这句管用了！
“谁让你骂我妈的！”
一声暴怒在顾平耳边炸开，他回头一看，那金丹黑袍的拳头已经在眼前了。
这一瞬间，顾平感受到了死亡。
轰——
一瞬间，一抹白影闪过，黑袍金丹又倒飞了回去。
黑袍金丹吐出了一口血。
顾平赌对了，赵清寒没走远。
她是故意离开，用顾平三人钓鱼的。
顾平想明白了她的做法之后，给她争取了这么一招。

这一招就让黑袍金丹吐血。
胜利的天平瞬间倾斜。
赵清寒出现之后，顾平终于不用装高手了。
腿肚子立即开始发软，抖得不停。
刚刚他离死亡太近了。
他怎么能不害怕啊……
黑袍金丹被一掌拍在地上，胸口已经结上了冰霜，他挣扎了片刻之后，迅速逃向城中身去，但这一次，赵清寒怎么会跟丢？
两人在城中激烈交手。
那人竟然可以和赵清寒打个不相上下。
楚玉皱眉，“那人还是隐藏了修为，他是金丹巅峰的修为，这一次来的如果不是圣女殿下的话，或许我们都得死。”
顾平皱眉。
幸好赵清寒够稳，没有在这些人出手的第一时间现身。
轰，一阵巨响，从顾平三人脚下响起。
劫后余生的三人立即摇晃了起来。
content_en:
"This person can see through the treasure they used to mask their aura, so there is a high probability that he also has such a treasure.
Not only that, when the Liyue Sect conquered the foundation-building experts, they actually brought an old man who was in the Qi-training stage. Wasn't this an initiative to create a breakthrough for them? This old man still has some immortal spirit... Now he has resorted to provocation... Who will do it? Only a fool would take action. "
Seeing that the black-robed leader was afraid to move forward, Gu Ping was stunned.
The demon cultivator is really thick-skinned. Why don't you take action?
"Forget it, telling you is in vain. Call your boss and let him talk to me."
The black-robed golden elixir smiled sadly, "Old Taoist, don't show off your words. Your method of provoking generals won't work with me."
He seemed very patient, but he was unwilling to attack first.
Gu Ping took a look and realized that this was not possible.
"Fuck you, I think you're really worthless."
Gu Ping cursed and was about to pick up Chu Yu and prepare to walk out.
But what he didn't expect was that this time, his curse would work!
"Who told you to scold my mother!"
A roar of rage exploded in Gu Ping's ears. When he looked back, the fist of the golden elixir and black robe was already in front of him.
At this moment, Gu Ping felt death.
Boom——
In an instant, a white shadow flashed past, and the black-robed golden elixir flew back.
The black-robed golden elixir spit out a mouthful of blood.
Gu Ping's bet was right, Zhao Qinghan didn't go far.
She left on purpose and used Gu Ping and the others to fish.
After Gu Ping figured out what she was doing, he got this move for her.
This move made the black-robed golden elixir vomit blood.
The balance of victory tilted instantly.
After Zhao Qinghan appeared, Gu Ping finally no longer had to pretend to be a master.
My calves immediately began to feel weak and they were shaking non-stop.
He had just come too close to death.
How could he not be afraid...
The black-robed golden elixir was slapped to the ground with a palm, and frost had formed on his chest. After struggling for a moment, he quickly fled towards the city. But this time, how could Zhao Qinghan lose him?
The two fought fiercely in the city.
That man could actually compete with Zhao Qinghan.
Chu Yu frowned, "That man still hid his cultivation. He is at the peak of the Golden Core. If Her Majesty the Saint hadn't come here this time, maybe we would all have died."
Gu Ping frowned.
Fortunately, Zhao Qinghan was stable enough and did not show up immediately when these people took action.
Boom, a loud noise sounded from the feet of Gu Ping and the others.
The three people who survived the disaster immediately started shaking.
